Drop duplicate lines from any list. The first occurrence of each line is kept.

📖 How to use

  1. Paste your list, one item per line, into the text area.
  2. Choose options: ignore case, trim whitespace, sort A-Z.
  3. Click "Remove duplicates".
  4. Copy or download the cleaned list; the removed-duplicates count is shown below.

❓ Frequently asked questions

Which copy is kept when lines repeat?

The first occurrence of each line is kept and later repeats are dropped, so the original order is preserved unless you enable sorting.

Does it treat "Apple" and "apple" as duplicates?

Yes. With "ignore case" on, "Apple" and "apple" count as the same line and only the first one is kept.

Is my list uploaded anywhere?

No. Everything runs locally in your browser — your list never leaves your device.
